vendorWebapp.description: The vendor directory or war compared against.

targetVendorWebapp.description: With --target-vendor (#305): the target version's vendor directory or war.

classCounts.description: With --target-vendor: entries per class, every class present.

mergeOut.description: With --out: the directory the merge inputs were written to.

path.description: Relative to the webapp, with / separators.

diff.description: INSTALLER files the vendor copy also has (#267): the unified diff from the vendor copy to the installed file, or a one-line notice for a binary or very large file.

class.description: With --target-vendor (#305, ADR-0057): what an upgrade to the target version means for this file.

target.description: With --target-vendor: how the vendor's file at this path changed from the source to the target version.

merge.description: With --out, for a MERGE file: the .mine, .base and .theirs files written.

tomcat.description: Present with --tomcat: the Tomcat-side files to carry over (issue #117).
